theorems.name: Submission.measure_bad_interior_exceptional_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (Bad : ℕ → ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (C : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ W → μ O ≤ liminf (fun q ↦ μs q O) atTop) → (∀ q k, Bad q k ⊆ W) → liminf a atTop ≠ ∞ → Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ q k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → μs q (Bad q k) ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (k : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * a q + b q) → μ (⋂ k : ℕ, ⋂ (_ : 1 ≤ k), ⋃ i : ℕ, interior (⋂ ℓ : ℕ, ⋂ (_ : i ≤ ℓ), Bad ℓ k)) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
